items.question: When booking UAE airline air tickets online, can you earn loyalty points for flying with the airline?
items.gold: Yes, you can earn loyalty points every time you fly with them.
items.fact: UAE airlines award loyalty points for each flight taken

items.question: Through which affiliated travel agencies can you book hotels and itineraries while booking UAE airline air tickets?
items.gold: Etihad Holidays, Emirates Holidays, Dnata, and Sharjah Airport Travel Agency.
items.fact: Four affiliated agencies offer hotel and itinerary booking with tickets
